title: Internal Mobility Swap Launch Playbook — 30/90
summary: Playbook to run a targeted internal mobility campaign that prioritizes rapid redeployment of high-potential contributors into roles with urgent capacity needs. Includes outreach cadence, adapted interview rubric for internal candidates, explicit leveling guidance, and a phased 30/60/90 onboarding checklist.
objectives: 1) Fill 6 priority roles from internal pool within 90 days. 2) Reduce ramp time by leveraging institutional knowledge. 3) Maintain transparent leveling and compensation decisions to reduce churn.
scope: Applies to lateral and promotional moves across engineering and product orgs. Excludes executive hires, contractor conversions, and externally-sourced emergency fills unless explicitly noted.
audience: People Ops, Hiring Managers, Talent Partners, Eng Leads, Finance approvers, Legal reviewer
timeline: Campaign kickoff: 2026-02-15; Outreach window: 2 weeks; Interview window: weeks 3-5; Offers by week 6; Starts rolling between 30-90 days depending on backfill and notice periods.
roles_and_priorities: Priority list for this pilot: Backend infra engineer (2 hires), ML infra engineer (1), Product manager (1), SRE (1), Solutions engineer (1). Owners: Eng Managers + assigned People Ops recruiter per role.
candidate_sourcing_notes: Target sources: high-potential individuals from last calibration, IDP signups, voluntary interest form responses, and manager nominations. Channels: internal bulletin, manager-led outreach templates, 1:1 nudges. Encourage managers to hold neutral exploratory conversations before formal application.
interview_rubric:
Scoring scale 1-4 (1=Below expectations, 4=Exceptional). Categories and guidance:
• Role fit & impact potential — evidence of measurable outcomes; 1 = no relevant impact, 4 = led cross-functional project with clear metrics.
• Technical depth (engineering) / product judgment (PM) — focus on design tradeoffs, debugging, and system-level thinking.
• System familiarity — internal knowledge weighted +0.5 for internal candidates (showing ability to hit ground running).
• Collaboration & communication — stakeholder management, async writing samples, and mentorship examples.
• Learning velocity & growth mindset — examples of rapid upskilling and ownership transitions.
• Leveling checklist — map examples to IC2/IC3/IC4 competencies; require explicit evidence for each competency.
Interview panel: hiring manager + cross-team peer + People Ops talent partner. Calibration: collect rubric scores + one-line evidence; median score >= 3 required to progress.
leveling_and_compensation_guidance: Default approach: keep current level, allow +/-1 level moves for scope changes with manager + People Ops calibration. Promotion decisions require approval from People Ops and Finance. Compensation: internal equity check mandatory for promotions; use expedited HR Ops comp workflow (see JIRA:HR-4821).
onboarding_checklist_30_90: Day 0-7: admin (access, equipment, payroll), role kick-off doc populated, buddy assigned, first-week measurable goal defined, intro meetings scheduled. Weeks 2-4: architecture & codebase deep dive, shadowing sessions, first scoped deliverable assigned, weekly 1:1 cadence. Weeks 5-8: ownership of small project, on-call/troubleshooting intro for infra roles, mid-point calibration checkpoint at week 8. Weeks 9-12: ownership transfer complete, cross-team syncs established, career-plan update, formal 90-day review with feedback and next milestones. Checklist items: repo access, infra credentials, runbook tour, key contacts list, OKR alignment doc, security training completion.
comms_and_manager_templates: Templates included: internal bulletin announcement, manager outreach email script, Slack DM for candidate outreach, offer acceptance message, backfill request email. Manager guidance doc explains framing for exploratory conversations, counteroffer handling, and expectations for handoffs/backfills.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: delayed backfill causing downstream capacity gaps — mitigate by running parallel external hiring pipeline for critical roles. Risk: inconsistent leveling decisions creating morale issues — mitigate via a 7-day calibration panel with People Ops + Hiring Manager + Eng Director. Risk: knowledge gaps in new role — mitigate with structured 30-day shadow plan and mandatory runbook walkthroughs.
metrics_and_success_criteria: KPIs: percent roles filled internally, median time-to-productive (first PR merged + first scoped deliverable completed), retention at 6 months, participant & manager satisfaction NPS. Targets: >=60% internal fill rate for campaign roles; median time-to-productive <45 days.

follow_up_actions: Actions: create intake ticket per role (JIRA prefix HR-INT-), schedule calibration session in week 2, publish campaign progress update at week 7, run retro at week 12. Owner assignments to be posted to #people-ops-internal-mobility channel.
